question: What proud thought did Moses warn Israel against, and what truth should they remember instead?
options: Thinking their armies won the land; instead God fought for them
Thinking their own power produced their wealth; instead God gives the ability to produce wealth
Thinking the land was empty; instead nations lived there
Thinking they were the oldest nation; instead others came first
explanation: Moses warned against thinking their own power and strength had produced their wealth, telling them to remember that it is God who gives the ability to produce wealth.
